text_en: He left that place and came to his hometown, and his disciples followed him.
text_cn: 耶稣从那里起身，来到自己的家乡，门徒也跟了他来。

text_en: On the sabbath he began to teach in the synagogue, and many who heard him were astounded. They said, “Where did this man get all this? What is this wisdom that has been given to him? What deeds of power are being done by his hands!
text_cn: 到了安息日，他便开始在会堂里教训人：众人听了，就惊讶说：“他这一切是从哪里来的呢？所赐给他的是什么样的智慧？怎么借他的手行出这样的奇能？

text_en: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary and brother of James and Joses and Judas and Simon, and are not his sisters here with us? ” And they took offense at him.
text_cn: 这人不就是那个木匠吗？他不是玛利亚的儿子，雅各伯、若瑟、犹达、西满的兄弟吗？他的姊妹不是也都在我们这里吗？”他们便对他起了反感。

text_en: Then Jesus said to them, “Prophets are not without honor, except in their hometown, and among their own kin, and in their own house. ”
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“先知除了在自己的本乡、本族和本家外，是没有不受尊敬的。”

text_en: And he could do no deed of power there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people and cured them.
text_cn: 耶稣在那里不能行什么奇能，只给少数的几个病人覆手，治好了他们。

text_en: And he was amazed at their unbelief. Then he went about among the villages teaching.
text_cn: 他因他们的无信心而感到诧异，遂周游四周各村施教去了。

text_en: He called the twelve and began to send them out two by two, and gave them authority over the unclean spirits.
text_cn: 耶稣叫来十二门徒，开始派遣他们两个两个地出去，赐给他们制伏邪魔的权柄，

text_en: He ordered them to take nothing for their journey except a staff; no bread, no bag, no money in their belts;
text_cn: 嘱咐他们在路上除了一根棍杖外，什么也不要带：不要带食物，不要带口袋，也不要在腰带里带铜钱；

text_en: but to wear sandals and not to put on two tunics.
text_cn: 却要穿鞋，不要穿两件内衣。

text_en: He said to them, “Wherever you enter a house, stay there until you leave the place.
text_cn: 又对他们说：“你们无论在哪里，进了一家，就住在那里，直到从那里离去；

text_en: If any place will not welcome you and they refuse to hear you, as you leave, shake off the dust that is on your feet as a testimony against them. ”
text_cn: 无论何处不接待你们，或不听从你们，你们就从那里出去，拂去你们脚下的尘土，作为反对他们的证据。”

text_en: So they went out and proclaimed that all should repent.
text_cn: 他们就出去宣讲，使人悔改，

text_en: They cast out many demons, and anointed with oil many who were sick and cured them.
text_cn: 并驱逐了许多魔鬼，且给许多病人傅油，治好了他们。

text_en: King Herod heard of it, for Jesus’ name had become known. Some were saying, “John the baptizer has been raised from the dead; and for this reason these powers are at work in him. ”
text_cn: 因为耶稣的名声传扬出去，黑落德王也听到了。有人说：“洗者若翰从死者中复活了，为此，这些奇能才在他身上运行。”

text_en: But others said, “It is Elijah. ” And others said, “It is a prophet, like one of the prophets of old. ”
text_cn: 但也有人说：“他是厄里亚。”更有人说：“他是先知，好像古先知中的一位。”

text_en: But when Herod heard of it, he said, “John, whom I beheaded, has been raised. ”
text_cn: 黑落德听了，却说：“是我所斩首的若翰复活了！”

text_en: For Herod himself had sent men who arrested John, bound him, and put him in prison on account of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, because Herod had married her.
text_cn: 原来这个黑落德，为了他兄弟斐理伯的妻子黑落狄雅的原故，因为他娶了她为妻，曾遣人逮捕了若翰，把他押在监里；

text_en: For John had been telling Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife. ”
text_cn: 因为若翰曾给黑落德说：“你不可占有你兄弟的妻子。”

text_en: And Herodias had a grudge against him, and wanted to kill him. But she could not,
text_cn: 黑落狄雅便怀恨他，愿意杀害他，只是不能，

text_en: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and he protected him. When he heard him, he was greatly perplexed; and yet he liked to listen to him.
text_cn: 因为黑落德敬畏若翰，知道他是一个正义圣洁的人，曾保全了他；几时听他讲道，就甚觉困惑，但仍乐意听他。

text_en: But an opportunity came when Herod on his birthday gave a banquet for his courtiers and officers and for the leaders of Galilee.
text_cn: 好机会的日子到了：当黑落德在自己的生日上，为自己的重要官员、军官和加里肋亚的显要，设了筵席的时候，

text_en: When his daughter Herodias came in and danced, she pleased Herod and his guests; and the king said to the girl, “Ask me for whatever you wish, and I will give it. ”
text_cn: 那个黑落狄雅的女儿便进来跳舞，获得了黑落德和同席人的欢心。王便对女孩子说：“你要什么，向我求罢！我必赐给你！”

text_en: And he solemnly swore to her, “Whatever you ask me, I will give you, even half of my kingdom. ”
text_cn: 又对她发誓说：“无论你求我什么，就是我王国的一半，我也必定给你！”

text_en: She went out and said to her mother, “What should I ask for? ” She replied, “The head of John the baptizer. ”
text_cn: 她便出去问她的母亲说：“我该求什么？”她母亲答说：“洗者若翰的头。”

text_en: Immediately she rushed back to the king and requested, “I want you to give me at once the head of John the Baptist on a platter. ”
text_cn: 她便立刻进去，到王面前要求说：“我要你立刻把洗者若翰的头，放在盘子里给我！”

text_en: The king was deeply grieved; yet out of regard for his oaths and for the guests, he did not want to refuse her.
text_cn: 王遂十分忧郁；但为了誓言和同席的人，不愿对她食言，

text_en: Immediately the king sent a soldier of the guard with orders to bring John’s head. He went and beheaded him in the prison,
text_cn: 王遂即差遣卫兵，吩咐把若翰的头送来。卫兵便去，在监里斩了若翰的头，

text_en: brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the girl. Then the girl gave it to her mother.
text_cn: 把他的头放在盘子里送来，交给了那女孩子，那女孩子便交给了自己的母亲。

text_en: When his disciples heard about it, they came and took his body, and laid it in a tomb.
text_cn: 若翰的门徒听说了，就来领去了他的尸身，把他安葬在坟墓里。

text_en: The apostles gathered around Jesus, and told him all that they had done and taught.
text_cn: 宗徒们聚集到耶稣跟前，将他们所作所教的一切，都报告给耶稣。

text_en: He said to them, “Come away to a deserted place all by yourselves and rest a while. ” For many were coming and going, and they had no leisure even to eat.
text_cn: 耶稣向他们说：“你们来，私下到荒野的地方去休息一会儿！”这是因为来往的人很多，以致他们连吃饭的工夫也没有。

text_en: And they went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.
text_cn: 他们便乘船私下往荒野的地方去了。

text_en: Now many saw them going and recognized them, and they hurried there on foot from all the towns and arrived ahead of them.
text_cn: 人看见他们走了。许多人也知道他们要去的地方，便从各城徒步，一起往那里奔走，且在他们以先到了。

text_en: As he went ashore, he saw a great crowd; and he had compassion for them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd; and he began to teach them many things.
text_cn: 耶稣一下船，看见一大伙群众，就对他们动了怜悯的心，因为他们好像没有牧人的羊，遂开口教训他们许多事。

text_en: When it grew late, his disciples came to him and said, “This is a deserted place, and the hour is now very late;
text_cn: 时间已经很晚了，他的门徒来到他跟前说：“这地方是荒野，且时间已经很晚了，

text_en: send them away so that they may go into the surrounding country and villages and buy something for themselves to eat. ”
text_cn: 请你遣散他们，好叫他们往四周田舍村庄去，各自买东西吃。”

text_en: But he answered them, “You give them something to eat. ” They said to him, “Are we to go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread, and give it to them to eat? ”
text_cn: 耶稣却回答说：“你们自己给他们吃的罢！”门徒向他说：“我们去买二百块银钱的饼给他们吃吗？”

text_en: And he said to them, “How many loaves have you? Go and see. ” When they had found out, they said, “Five, and two fish. ”
text_cn: 耶稣问他们说：“你们有多少饼？去看看！”他们一知道了，就说：“五个饼，两条鱼。”

text_en: Then he ordered them to get all the people to sit down in groups on the green grass.
text_cn: 于是耶稣吩咐他们，叫众人一伙一伙地坐在青草地上。

text_en: So they sat down in groups of hundreds and of fifties.
text_cn: 人们就一组一组地坐下：或一百人，或五十人。

text_en: Taking the five loaves and the two fish, he looked up to heaven, and blessed and broke the loaves, and gave them to his disciples to set before the people; and he divided the two fish among them all.
text_cn: 耶稣拿起那五个饼和那两条鱼来，举目向天，祝福了，把饼掰开，递给门徒，叫他们摆在众人面前，把两条鱼也分给众人。

text_en: And all ate and were filled;
text_cn: 众人吃了，也都饱了；

text_en: and they took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and of the fish.
text_cn: 人就把剩余的碎块收了满满十二筐；还有鱼的碎块。

text_en: Those who had eaten the loaves numbered five thousand men.
text_cn: 吃饼的，男人就有五千。

text_en: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat and go on ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he dismissed the crowd.
text_cn: 耶稣即刻催迫门徒们上船，先到那边贝特赛达去，这其间他遣散了群众。

text_en: After saying farewell to them, he went up on the mountain to pray.
text_cn: 耶稣辞别了众人之后，便往山上祈祷去了。

text_en: When evening came, the boat was out on the sea, and he was alone on the land.
text_cn: 到了夜晚，船已在海中，耶稣独自在陆地上。

text_en: When he saw that they were straining at the oars against an adverse wind, he came towards them early in the morning, walking on the sea. He intended to pass them by.
text_cn: 他看见门徒艰苦地在摇橹，他们正遇着逆风。约夜间四更时分，耶稣步行海面，朝着他们走来，有意越过他们。

text_en: But when they saw him walking on the sea, they thought it was a ghost and cried out;
text_cn: 门徒看见他步行海上，以为是个妖怪，就都惊叫起来，

text_en: for they all saw him and were terrified. But immediately he spoke to them and said, “Take heart, it is I; do not be afraid. ”
text_cn: 因为众人都看见了他，遂都惊慌不已。耶稣连忙与他们讲话，向他们说：“放心！是我。不要怕！”

text_en: Then he got into the boat with them and the wind ceased. And they were utterly astounded,
text_cn: 遂到他们那里上了船，风就停了。他们心中越发惊奇，

text_en: for they did not understand about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.
text_cn: 因为他们还不明白关于增饼的事，他们的心还是迟钝。

text_en: When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret and moored the boat.
text_cn: 他们渡到了陆地，来到革乃撒勒，就靠了岸。

text_en: When they got out of the boat, people at once recognized him,
text_cn: 他们刚一下船，人立刻认出他来，

text_en: and rushed about that whole region and began to bring the sick on mats to wherever they heard he was.
text_cn: 便跑遍那全地域，开始用床把有病的人，抬到听说耶稣所在的地方去。

text_en: And wherever he went, into villages or cities or farms, they laid the sick in the marketplaces, and begged him that they might touch even the fringe of his cloak; and all who touched it were healed.
text_cn: 凡耶稣所到的地方，或村庄，或城市，或乡间，人都把患病的人放在街道上，求耶稣容许他们，至少摸摸他的衣边；凡摸到他的，就都痊愈了。
